title: The Principle of Equivalent Exchange
decree: Everything has a price. No knowledge or blessing is granted without commensurate reciprocation.

title: Secrecy Above the Gray Fog
decree: The affairs and deliberations of the Divine Hall shall never be uttered to the mundane ear.

title: Do Not Pry Into Deities
decree: Knowledge is dangerous. Mortals who seek forbidden truths beyond their sequence invite madness and corruption.

title: Anchor of Humanity
decree: Remember you are merely acting. Never let the potion's will overcome your fundamental mortal anchor.

title: Council Subordination
decree: Respect the seat of the Celestial Worthy, the mandate of The Fool, and the executors of the Divine Table.
